checks.name: independent_inherited_stdin

checks.name: negative_git_outcomes
checks.details: CalledProcessError128 and TimeoutExpired propagate; invalid revision raises RuntimeError. stdin=DEVNULL, check=True and timeout=10 asserted.

checks.name: historical_diagnostic_interpretation
